Also present: Paul Duncan, Homeless Services Bureau Manager, Jennifer Santana, Secretary.

  Yes:  3 Wood, Lie, Howat

  • Staff and the subcommittee reviewed the four outstanding MOUs. The total
  obligated amount across all grants is $13,638.81. As of August 28, 2025, the
  available balance in the Mayor’s Fund is $156,640.84.
  o Member Lie requested that the Allocation Summary on the Homeless
  Services website be updated to reflect the current organizations
  awarded grants through the Mayor’s Fund.

3.  25-56532  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund standard operating procedures
  (SOP) verbiage updates.

  A motion was made by Member Wood, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Wood, Lie, Howat
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Subcommittee members expressed interest in reviewing Mayor’s Fund
  applications at the time they are initially screened by staff, preferring to
  discuss each application as it is received.
  • The members approved a motion to adopt the SOP draft, with the
  amendment of removing the word threshold referenced in Part One,
  Paragraph Two.

4.  25-56533  Recommendation to review and discuss the Mayor’s Fund grant application and

  Yes:  3  Wood, Lie, Howat
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • This item will be carried forward to the November meeting.

5.  25-56534  Recommendation to approve the Mayor’s Fund Subcommittee grant application
  submitted by Priceless Investors for funding in the amount of $10,000.

  A motion was made by Member Wood, seconded by Member Lie, to approve
  recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Wood, Lie, Howat
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • Kimberly Hall, CEO of Priceless Investors, an organization that recently
  applied for the Mayor’s Fund, attended the meeting in person and provided
  an overview of the organization and its work.
  • The committee engaged in further discussion about the organization, with
  particular questions directed toward its re-entry programs and relationships
  with partner agencies.
  • The subcommittee moved to approve the application. It will be presented to
  the full Homeless Services Advisory Committee on Wednesday, October 1,
  2025.

6.  25-56535  Recommendation to receive and file a discussion on the fundraising strategies for
  the Mayor’s Fund.

  A motion was made by Member Wood, seconded by Member Lie, to approve

  Yes:  3  Wood, Lie, Howat
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 0  None

  • This item will be carried forward to the November meeting.
